This is an environmental liability policy. It has two sections.

[[ref:env.cover.contractors-pollution-liability]] covers claims and clean-up costs arising from pollution caused by the work you carry out at other people's sites.

[[ref:env.cover.site-pollution-legal-liability]] covers claims and clean-up costs arising from pollution on, at, under or migrating from the locations shown in the schedule. It applies only if the schedule shows it.

This policy is written on a claims-made and notified basis. It covers claims first made against you, and pollution conditions first discovered by you, during the policy period and notified to us during the policy period or any extended reporting period, for pollution conditions that began after the retroactive date.

This policy covers gradual pollution and the clean-up costs that environmental law requires, which public liability policies usually exclude. [[ref:env.cover.relationship-with-public-liability-insurance]] explains how it works together with your public and products liability policy.

This policy, together with your schedule and any endorsements shown in it, forms your contract of insurance with us. Where the schedule and this wording differ, the schedule applies. Words with special meanings are listed in [[ref:env.section.definitions]].

This wording is written for businesses. It is not itself a Product Disclosure Statement. [WP REVIEW: confirm that environmental liability insurance is not a retail general insurance product under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) s.761G and the Corporations Regulations, so that no PDS or TMD is required.]
